prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Make a production pixel-art animation spritesheet of ONLY this EXACT reference monster. Preserve anatomy, body proportions, color identity and distinguishing accessory. EXACTLY FIVE ROWS x THREE COLUMNS, 15 full-body sprites, consistent body scale with transparent gutters. ROW1 battle all face LEFT three-quarter view: idle, compact attack, hurt recoil. ROW2 walk DOWN toward viewer; ROW3 walk LEFT; ROW4 walk RIGHT; ROW5 walk UP away, clear BACK view without face. Each walk row has neutral, first step, opposite step or species-appropriate flowing/hopping motion; all three different. Keep whole body inside each cell, separate rows and columns, 15% padding. Natural readable pixel clusters, enough bright highlights, crisp outlines, no blur or smooth painting, no ground, shadow, grid, letters or detached effects. Background genuinely transparent. Intended for battle96x96 displayed72px and walk32x48. Preserve accessory in every pose and direction, and keep eyes visibly luminous. Any pale gaps in the reference are background and must be transparent. Never convert this creature into a human wearing costume. RIONE: warm rust-red/brown body, BRIGHT GREEN hair clasp and RED tassel/tuft, glowing GREEN eyes and flower centers. Keep both the green clasp and red tuft prominent in every pose. No navy cloth, white bandages or purple flowers. Spirit: preserve the exact swirling apparition, eye number, spiral ribbons, accessory and colors. No invented limbs. Compact left-directed swirling attack, hurt lean, walk as three hovering sway states; no eyes in back view.
